title: Budgets
intro: Set how much you want to spend each month. You get a gentle warning at 80%.
emptyBody: Pick a category and how much you want to spend on it each month.
pickGroup: All of {name}, or one part of it?
reportEmptyBody: Add a budget in Settings to compare what you spent with what you planned.
saveFailed: Couldn't save the budget. Try again.

warnNear.1: Heads up! {name} is at {percent}% of this month's budget 🌼

warnNear.3: {name} is at {percent}%. A little care and you'll land right on target 👍

warnOver.1: {name} went {amount} over this month. No worries, next month is a fresh start 🌱
warnOver.2: Oops! {name} is {amount} over budget. It happens to the best families 😄
warnOver.3: {name} is {amount} past its budget. Maybe a cosy week at home? ☕

homeMore: {name} and {more} more need a gentle look 🌼

allGood.1: Every budget is on track. Lovely! 🎉
allGood.2: All within budget, well done family 💚
allGood.3: Right on course, keep it up 🌟

starterHint: We added a few budgets to start you off. Tap any one to make it yours ✏️
